connection: per-call sqlite3.connect via get_connection() helper (sqlite3 stdlib)
queries: availability query on flights (route, date, seats_available) plus one price lookup per flight executed inside a loop
n_plus_one: yes: one price query per available flight inside the loop in search_flights

optimization_targets.description: Replace the availability query plus per-flight price lookups with a single JOIN of flights and prices so one round trip returns all data
Add an index on (origin, destination, flight_date) to support the search WHERE clause

notes: Flights without a price row must still be excluded, results must be ordered by departure time, and the lowest-fare helper must return the same fare or None
